value.produces: assets/nokia9300 (eka2l1/: the Wnt/EKA2L1 s80-epoc7-tables build via emulators/build-eka2l1.sh; rootfs/: the nspawn trixie runtime root, uid-shifted to 2621440) and golden/ (the RAE-6 device data dir: SYM.ROM, the Z: tree, the C: drive and EKA2L1 config.yml; relaunch reset)

labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE, SANDBOXED, NO CHECKPOINT: EKA2L1 (the Symbian HLE emulator, our fork github.com/Wnt/EKA2L1 branch s80-shell, GPL-3) runs the Nokia 9300's own firmware 5.22 (RAE-6: Symbian OS 7.0s, Series 80 v2) inside a systemd-nspawn container (private PID/mount/net/user namespaces, host uid range 2621440+, rootfs --volatile=overlay, the EKA2L1 build and the golden data dir bound read-only, only work/ and the X socket dir writable, capabilities dropped, @mount filtered). Xvfb :119 at 1280x400 lives INSIDE the container; its root IS the 640x200 inner screen at exactly 2x (nokia9300-inner.sh resizes and moves the Qt window so the display widget sits at 0,0; the menubar and status bar hang off the root). The daemon captures the X root (SH_CAPTURE=x11) and types over XTEST (SH_INPUT_BACKEND=x11test, SH_X11TEST_KEYMAP=x11test.keysyms). No QEMU/QMP, no exec channel, no network (lo only). NO POINTER: the 9300 has none. KEYS per agent K1's keymap contract v1 (provisional until framebuffer proof): F1-F4 = the four command buttons beside the screen, F5-F12 = Desk / Telephone / Messaging / Web / Contacts / Documents / Calendar / My own, Menu, F13-F17 = joystick centre/up/down/left/right, ISO_Level3_Shift = Chr; printable characters as their own keysyms. Reset=relaunch: a fresh copy of the golden data dir + a cold start of Desk (0x101f8e4f), ~3.5 s; the inner loop also relaunches EKA2L1 whenever it exits. Drive it with xdotool on DISPLAY=:119 from labrun, or `labctl shot nokia9300`.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# nokia9300 (VMID 219) — host-native EKA2L1 (Wnt/EKA2L1 fork) running the Nokia 9300's own firmware
# (Symbian OS 7.0s, Series 80 v2) inside a pinned 1280x400 Xvfb whose root is the 640x200 inner screen at

render.bindingComment: ideal: a Nokia 9300 Communicator lying open — the 640x200 screen above the QWERTY keyboard, the four command buttons to the right of the screen

pointer.device: none — the Nokia 9300 has no pointing device and no touchscreen: Series 80 is driven by the four command buttons, the joystick and the keyboard. The x11test backend is present for KEYS only (SH_X11TEST_KEYS=1).

museum.lineage: Nokia Communicator (9000, 9110, 9210, then the 9300 and 9500 on Series 80 v2)
museum.arch: TI OMAP1510 (ARM925T @ 150 MHz), 64 MB RAM, 640x200 65,536-colour inner display, QWERTY keyboard, clamshell
eraSoftware: Documents and Sheet, the Communicator's word processor and spreadsheet
museum.periodBrowser: Opera 6.0 for Symbian OS, build 543 (the built-in Web application, ROM oprmodel.dll)
museum.blurb: A Nokia 9300 Communicator running its own firmware: closed it is a phone, opened it is a 640x200 landscape screen over a full QWERTY keyboard, with four command buttons beside the screen whose labels change with the application. Symbian OS 7.0s with the Series 80 v2 interface, firmware 5.22 (November 2005).
museum.notes: Dark-launched streamhost station, HOST-NATIVE and CONTAINED: EKA2L1 (our fork of the Symbian HLE emulator, GPL-3) runs the RAE-6 firmware inside a systemd-nspawn sandbox with an Xvfb of its own; the daemon captures the X root and types over XTEST. The Qt window is placed so the 1280x400 root is the 640x200 screen at exactly 2x. Reset = relaunch from a pristine copy of the device data dir (ROM, Z: tree, C: drive). See docs/guests/nokia9300.md.

emulator.version: Wnt/EKA2L1 fork, branch s80-shell @ 19308cbd0 = s80-epoc7-tables (upstream master 39858137e + the Series 80 v2 window-server table, kind-checked handles, FBS font heights, Posix stat) + agent B1's application-button switching
emulator.driver: RAE-6 (Nokia 9300), epoc7, firmware 5.22 SYM.ROM + Z: tree; --run 0x101f8e4f (Desk)

network.note: No network yet: the container runs --private-network (lo only). The retronet web plane for Opera is agents N1/N2's (EKA2L1 needs the Symbian OS 7.0s socket-server table first); no retronet reservation is held and no rn-tapnet.sh is committed until that plane is proven (AGENTS.md rule 15).

reset.mouse: N/A — the Nokia 9300 has no pointing device and no touchscreen; the exhibit publishes no pointer (stream.pointer.present=false).
reset.keyboard: PARTIAL (2026-09-24) — keymap contract v1 (agent K1): the daemon resolves all 108 scancodes of the station keymap against the container's Xvfb (F13-F17 bound through a patched -xkbdir), and on the dark-launch rig XTEST F10 brought Documents to the front (command buttons Insert object / Font / Style / Exit), F5 brought Desk back (Open / Write note / Note list) and F10 Documents again — the s80-shell binary with agent B1's bindings in the golden. Command buttons, Menu, Chr, the joystick and typing are not framebuffer-proven on the station yet; a third app launched at the same time stays black (B1/B4), so the exhibit is Desk + one app at a time.
reset.fixture: Desk, the Series 80 v2 shell, as the 9300 firmware 5.22 draws it in EKA2L1: the Desk icon at the top left and the command-button labels Open / Write note / Note list down the right edge, the screen at exactly 2x in a 1280x400 root. resetMode=relaunch with no state: the launcher kills the container, the inner script copies the golden data dir fresh and cold-starts Desk (~3.5 s on an idle host, 11 s at load 96). Golden = agent F1's working data dir of 2026-09-24 plus C:\System\SharedData\10000865.ini (the ROM's own default with LanguageSelectionDone=1, so Startup's first-boot language wizard never runs) and agent B1's keymap-contract bindings/default.yml: 3249 files, 68 106 617 B, tree manifest sha256 069a6674568325129bd02f151b3c802dc364023f41d948f4900e5b1118be5c17; staged on the box at /data/assets-staging/symbian-s80/nokia9300-golden and gated by tiles/nokia9300.sh --golden.
